ctx.x: I didn't see him. Yeh, but I didn't see him. We didn't see -- no one saw him. But he must have been there, because we were told after that he was the type of man, his eyes were -- what would you say, "cross-eyed", and he -- each eye was looking in a different direction, not cross-eyed, but --
